svg.aria-label: A royalty counter at 2,760 dollars of a 3,000 dollar yearly limit, where a deal asking for 720 dollars is charged only the 240 dollars of room left
svg.text: A 6% royalty that stops at $3,000 a year
The royalty counter for one agent, late in the cap year:
A $12,000 commission would owe 6%, which is $720.
Only $240 is charged. The other $480 stays in the deal.
That is a second counter, running alongside the agent's split cap.
